sugar cookie cinnamon rolls 🎄✨   recipe: tangzhong: ¼ cup milk (60g) 1 tbsp all-purpose flour (8g) whisk together in a small pan over medium-low heat until it thickens into a paste. let cool slightly before adding to the dough. cinnamon roll dough: ¾ cup warm milk (180ml) ¼ cup melted butter (57g) ¼ cup granulated sugar (50g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 egg + 1 egg yolk 1 tsp almond extract  1 tsp cake batter extract  tangzhong 3 cups bread flour (360g), plus up to ½ cup (60g) as needed 2 tbsp milk powder (15g) ¾ tsp salt (4g) mix the warm milk, sugar, and yeast together and let sit for about 5 minutes until foamy. add the melted butter, egg, egg yolk, and tangzhong. mix until combined. add the milk powder and salt, then gradually add the flour. start with 3 cups and add more as needed until you have a soft, smooth dough. i ended up using about 3½ cups total. if kneading by hand, try not to add too much extra flour. lightly oil your hands and work surface if needed. place in a greased bowl, cover, and let rise until doubled, being careful not to overproof. sugar cookie filling: ½ cup salted butter, softened (113g) ¾ cup granulated sugar (150g) 1 egg  1 tsp vanilla extract ½ tsp almond extract ¼ tsp butter extract (optional) 1¼ cups all-purpose flour (150g) 1 tsp cinnamon  ¼ tsp salt cream together the softened butter and sugar until fluffy. mix in the egg, vanilla, almond extract, and butter extract. gradually add the flour and and salt until a soft cookie dough forms. assembling the rolls: once the cinnamon roll dough has doubled in size, roll it out into a rectangle, keeping it about ¾ inch thick. spread the sugar cookie dough evenly over the surface. sprinkle Christmas nonpareils over the sugar cookie layer. cut the dough into approximately 12 strips, then roll each strip individually. arrange the rolls in a lined baking dish. cover and let rise again for about 25–35 minutes, until slightly puffier. don’t let them overproof. before baking: heavy cream, for brushing lightly brush the tops of the rolls with heavy cream before baking. bake at 350°F for about 25–30 minutes, or until cooked through. baking time may vary depending on your oven. if they brown too quickly, tent loosely with foil. sugar cookie frosting: ½ cup softened salted butter (113g) 2 oz cream cheese, softened (57g) 2 cups powdered sugar (240g) 1 tsp vanilla bean paste ½ tsp almond extract ¼ tsp butter extract (optional) 1–2 tbsp heavy cream, as needed whip the butter and cream cheese until fluffy. add the powdered sugar, vanilla, almond extract, and butter extract. mix until smooth and fluffy, adding heavy cream as needed to reach your desired consistency. spread over the slightly warm rolls and finish with extra Christmas sprinkles!     #christmas #sugarcookies Nashville Hot Chicken Caesar Sandwich 🌶️ Ingredients Chicken 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breasts, pounded evenly Salt, to taste Oil, for deep-frying Nashville Hot Seasoning 1 tbsp cayenne pepper 2 tbsp brown sugar 1 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tsp black pepper 1 tbsp garlic powder 1 tbsp onion powder 2 tsp salt (Mix all seasoning ingredients together. Some will remain after preparing the chicken, flour, buttermilk, and hot oil.) Seasoned Flour 2 cups all-purpose flour 1/2 cup cornstarch 1 tsp baking powder 2 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Buttermilk Mixture 2 cups buttermilk 2 large eggs 1 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Nashville Hot Oil 1/2 cup hot frying oil 2 tbsp Nashville hot seasoning Caesar Dressing 1/2 cup mayonnaise 2 tbsp freshly grated Parmesan 1 tbsp lemon juice 1 tsp Dijon mustard 1 tsp Worcestershire sauce 1 small garlic clove, finely grated 1/2 tsp black pepper 1–2 tbsp cold water, as needed Salt, to taste Caesar Salad 1 cup finely chopped romaine 2–3 tbsp Caesar dressing 1–2 tbsp freshly grated Parmesan Assembly 5–6 toasted brioche or rustic buns Dill pickle slices Parmesan cheese Extra Caesar dressing, as needed Instructions Cut chicken into 5–6 sandwich-sized pieces, pound evenly, and season lightly with salt. Whisk all Caesar dressing ingredients until smooth. Add water as needed, adjust salt and lemon, and refrigerate. Mix flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and 2 tbsp seasoning. In another bowl, whisk buttermilk, eggs, and 1 tbsp seasoning. Coat chicken in flour, dip in buttermilk, then coat in flour again, pressing to create a craggy crust. Rest on a wire rack for 5–10 minutes. Heat oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry in batches until golden and crispy and the internal temperature reaches 165°F (74°C). Drain on a wire rack. Carefully whisk 2 tbsp seasoning into 1/2 cup hot frying oil. Brush a thin layer over both sides of the chicken, adjusting to taste. Toss romaine with Caesar dressing and Parmesan just before assembling. Spread Caesar dressing on toasted buns. Add dressed lettuce, hot chicken, pickles, and Parmesan. Finish with extra dressing on the top bun, if desired. #nashville #hotchicken #sandwich #recipe

Crispy Garlic Parmesan Chicken Wraps🍗🧀🌯 The flavours are absolutely phenomenal, one of the best wraps made using a sheet pan. Low effort, minimal cleanup and incredibly delicious🔥 Great to serve for large groups/gatherings at home Macros Per Wrap (10 Total) 423 Calories | 41g Protein | 25g Carbs | 18g Fat Ingredients (Makes 10 Wraps) Garlic Parmesan Chicken - 600g Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cut into cubes - 600g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Chilli Flakes - 3 Tsp Parsley - 4 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Paprika - 4 Tsp Garlic Granules or Powder - 200g Grated Parmesan - 6 Tsp Olive Oil - Avocado Cooking Spray (use before baking) Garlic Pamesan Creamy Sauce - 350g Light Evaporated Milk - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1 Tsp Paprika - 80g Grated Parmesan - 100g Light Cream Cheese - 15g Light Butter Wraps & Filling - 10 Low Carb Wraps (Brand: Mission) - Shredded Lettuce - Chopped Tomatoes - Chopped Onions 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Slice chicken breast and thighs into cubes. Add seasonings with grated parmesan cheese and drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated. 2. In a pan on low heat, add light butter with seasonings. Toast for a minute before adding evaporated milk, extra Parmesan and cream cheese. Stir till smooth and creamy. 3. Line a sheet pan with parchment paper, spread marinated chicken evenly (do not overcrowd), add light layer of cooking spray then bake in a preheated oven for 20-22 mins at 200C until crispy. 4. While chicken is still hot, add extra parmesan and parsley. Mix well until coated and extra cheesy. 5. Assemble the wraps with shredded lettuce, onion, tomato, crispy chicken and sauce. ENJOY! Storage and Reheating Tips - Store chicken and creamy sauce in separate containers in the fridge. - When ready to eat, just warm up chicken in oven/air fryer for 4-5 mins 180C / 370F. 30-Minute Garlic Butter Steak Bites & Potatoes 🥩🥔🧄 If you need a quick and easy dinner idea, you have to try these garlic butter steak bites and potatoes! The potatoes are perfectly seasoned and crispy, and the steak is juicy, tender, and tossed in the most delicious garlic butter. And the best part? You can have dinner on the table in about 30 minutes! 🤤 RECIPE BELOW ⬇️  Potatoes: * 4 russet potatoes, diced * 2 tbsp olive oil * 1 tsp each: salt, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika & Italian seasoning * ½ tsp black pepper Steak: * 1½ lbs sirloin tip steak, cubed * 1 tsp olive oil * 1–2 tsp Montreal steak seasoning * 1 tbsp oil for cooking * 2 tbsp butter * 3 cloves garlic, minced * Fresh parsley Instructions 👩🏽‍🍳 1. Wash, peel, and dice your potatoes. Toss with olive oil and seasonings. Salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Italian seasoning. Y’all know I don’t measure. I just season until my ancestors tell me to stop! 😂 2. Air fry at 400°F for 20–25 minutes, shaking halfway through, until crispy. You can also bake at 425°F for 25–30 minutes or pan-fry! 3. While those cook, cut your steak into bite-sized pieces and toss with a little olive oil and steak seasoning. I used Montreal, but use your favorite! 4. Get your skillet nice and hot! Add a little oil and sear steak for about 2 minutes per side until browned. Cast iron works best, but any skillet will do! 5. Reduce heat, scoot steak to the edges, and add butter and garlic. Cook for 30–60 seconds until fragrant, then toss everything in that garlic butter. 6. Turn off the heat, add your crispy potatoes, gently mix, and top with fresh parsley! Serve with cheesy rice, mac and cheese, asparagus, or whatever your heart desires! ❤️ Save this for your next easy weeknight dinner! 🔖 #GarlicButterSteakBites #SteakAndPotatoes #30MinuteMeals #EasyDinnerIdeas #WeeknightDinners

My first cozy recipe of the season had to be a little spooky🤭🎃👻 Save this recipe for later☺️ Creamy Tomato Soup & Vegan Grilled Cheese Ingredients: • 5 ripe tomatoes • 2 bell peppers • 1 onion • 2 whole heads of garlic • 2 tbsp balsamic vinegar • 3 tbsp olive oil • 1-2 cups (240-480 ml) vegetable broth • 1 small bunch fresh basil • Fresh rosemary • Salt & black pepper Grilled cheese: • Bread of choice • Vegan butter • Vegan cheese How to make the soup: 1. Cut the tomatoes and bell peppers in half, chop the onion, and cut the tops off the garlic heads. 2. Place everything on a baking sheet, drizzle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar, and season with salt and fresh rosemary. 3. Roast at 350°F (180°C) for 40-50 minutes, until soft. 4. Squeeze the roasted garlic cloves out of their skins and transfer everything to a pot. 5. Add fresh basil, black pepper, and 1 cup of vegetable broth, then blend until creamy and smooth. Cheesy Garlic Potato Bread 🥔🧀 Prep Time: 1 hr 40 mins | Cook Time: 25 mins | Servings: 6-8 INGREDIENTS Soft Milk Dough 3 cups bread flour, plus extra for dusting 1 cup whole or 2% milk, warmed to 105°F-110°F 2 tsp instant yeast (1 standard packet) 1 tbsp granulated sugar (or honey) 1 1/2 tsp kosher salt 2 tbsp extra-virgin olive oil, plus extra for greasing Creamy Gold Potato and Mozzarella Filling 1 lb Yukon Gold potatoes (about 2 medium-large), peeled and cut into 1-inch chunks 1 1/2 tbsp unsalted butter 1 1/2 tbsp mayonnaise (or sour cream/cream cheese) 1-2 tbsp milk, as needed 1/2 tsp kosher salt (plus salt for boiling water) 1/4 tsp freshly ground black pepper 1/4 tsp garlic powder 2 to 2 1/2 cups low-moisture mozzarella cheese, shredded Pan-Frying and Garlic Butter Finish 2-3 tbsp neutral oil or unsalted butter, divided 3 tbsp unsalted butter, melted 2-3 cloves garlic, finely grated or minced 2 tbsp fresh parsley, finely chopped 1/4 tsp kosher salt INSTRUCTIONS 1. Whisk warm milk, sugar, and instant yeast in a large bowl and let sit for 5 minutes until foamy. Add bread flour, 1 1/2 tsp kosher salt, and 2 tbsp olive oil, stirring until a shaggy dough forms. 2. Knead on a lightly floured surface for 6-8 minutes by hand (or 5-6 minutes in a stand mixer) until smooth and elastic. Place in a lightly oiled bowl, cover tightly, and let rise in a warm spot for 60-90 minutes until doubled. 3. Boil Yukon Gold potato chunks in salted water for 12-15 minutes until fork-tender. Drain thoroughly and return to the hot pot for 1 minute over low heat to evaporate excess moisture. 4. Mash potatoes smooth with 1 1/2 tbsp butter, mayonnaise, 1-2 tbsp milk, 1/2 tsp kosher salt, black pepper, and garlic powder. Cool completely to room temperature. 5. Punch down risen dough and divide into 8 equal balls. Roll each ball into a 5-inch circle, keeping the center slightly thicker than the edges. 6. Scoop 2 tbsp cooled mashed potatoes onto the center of a circle, flatten slightly, and top with a generous handful of shredded mozzarella, leaving a clean 1/2-inch border. 7. Gather dough edges over the filling, pinch the seam tightly shut, and place seam-side down on a lightly floured counter. Gently flatten with your palm and work into a 1/2-inch-thick disc. Repeat with remaining dough. 8. Heat 1 tbsp oil or butter in a large skillet over medium-low to medium heat. Cook 1-2 flatbreads for 3-4 minutes until golden-brown and blistered on the bottom. 9. Flip, press gently with a spatula, and cook for 2-3 minutes until golden on the second side. 10. Stir together 3 tbsp melted butter, grated garlic, chopped parsley, and 1/4 tsp salt. Brush generously over the hot flatbreads and serve immediately. #recipe #cooking #foodtok #asmr

Prepare the dipping bread: Cut the bread you removed from the center, along with the sourdough top, into bite-sized cubes. Arrange them on the baking sheet around the bread bowl. 7. Butter everything: Brush or toss the bread cubes with the remaining garlic butter until nicely coated. 8. Bake: Bake at 350°F for 25–30 minutes, flipping the bread cubes halfway through, until the Brie is melted and gooey and the bread is golden and toasted. 9. Serve: Let it cool slightly, then dig in! The highly requested full recipe for my dark chocolate French silk pie 🍫 Ingredients: Crust- 22 Oreo cookies, finely crushed  5 tablespoon unsalted butter, melted Filling- 8 oz (225 g) dark chocolate (70% - 85% cacao), chopped 4 large eggs ¾ cup (150 g) granulated sugar 10 tablespoons (140 g) unsalted butter, room temperature 2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract 1 ⅓ cups heavy cream 1 tablespoon powdered sugar Pinch of fine salt Whipped cream topping- 1¼ cups heavy cream  ¼ cup (28 g) powdered sugar  1 tsp. vanilla extract  pinch of fine salt Chocolate shavings Instructions: 1. Preheat the oven to 350°F. 2. Make the crust: in a medium bowl, combine the melted butter and finely-crushed Oreos. 3. Press the mixture into a 8-9 inch pie dish. I like to use a measuring cup to help press it in. 4. Bake for 10-12 mins. Set aside to cool completely. 5. Make the filling: melt the chocolate in the microwave or using a double boiler technique. Set aside to cool. 6. In a medium-sized heatproof bowl, whisk together the eggs and granulated sugar. Place over a pot of simmering water (double boiler style) and whisk constantly until the mixture thickens slightly. It should be pale, foamy, and slightly thickened to ensures the eggs are safe. 7. Once the chocolate has cooled a bit, whisk in the chocolate, vanilla and salt to the egg and sugar mixture. Set aside to cool, whisking occasionally so that it doesn't set. 8. In a large bowl, beat the softened butter for 2–3 minutes with an electric mixer until light and fluffy. Gradually add in the cooled chocolate mixture and mix for about 4-5 mins with and electric mixer on medium speed until glossy and lighter in texture. 9. In a separate bowl, whip the heavy cream and powdered sugar with an electric mixer until stiff peaks form. 10. Fold the whipped cream into the chocolate mixture in three additions. 11. Add the filling to the oreo pie crust. 12. Cover and chill for at least 6 hours until firm. 13. Before serving, make the whipped cream (use an electric mixer to whip the cream, powdered sugar and salt until stiff peaks form) and dollop onto the top of the pie. 14. Sprinkle with chocolate shavings, and serve. Enjoy and Happy Holidays! #christmasbaking #christmasrecipe #dessertrecipe #chocolaterecipe #pie
